However, when `src_contents` is an empty string (as in this test case), `lib2to3_parse` tries to access the last character of the string, leading to an `IndexError`.

```

This condition will raise an exception when `src_contents` is empty because trying to access `src_contents[-1]` throws an `IndexError`. Therefore, the bug lies in the incorrect assumption that `src_contents` will always have at least one character.

Conclusion: The test `test_empty` checks whether an empty string is correctly handled by the `format_str` function in the `black` module. However, due to a condition in `lib2to3_parse` attempting to access the last character of an empty string, an `IndexError: string index out of range` occurs, causing the test to fail.
